gates.notes: Immutable upstream revision is now pinned to 9d2b6ace3e23199e2a896de329d4c16489b09a96. The top-level README identifies FUNIT/ and base/modules/modules.py as third-party exceptions; dependency-closure license audit and reproducible baseline execution remain incomplete, so this gate remains BLOCKED.
Candidate sources are documented, but every asset intended for training still needs an individual license and training-permission decision.
The repository documents family-level splits; the local agent must verify the actual downloaded release, hashes, duplicate families, and split disjointness.
Existing samples are contextual full-line renders with logical target indices, not audited isolated target-glyph crops with verified HarfBuzz cluster mapping.
Schemas and templates exist, but a populated, provenance-reviewed paired prompt/measurement dataset has not been demonstrated.
The unified architecture is specified, but executable image encoder, prompt encoder, shared latent alignment, shared generator, and hybrid path have not been verified in this repository.
Required unit tests, forward/backward smoke tests, tiny-subset overfit, checkpoint round-trip, and resume tests have not been evidenced.
The local Windows preflight must be run on the actual machine; current GPU, VRAM, RAM, disk, backend compatibility, and runtime estimates are not established here.

Intermediate adapter code is committed. GitHub Actions successfully compiled both scripts and passed four deterministic episode-sampler unit tests. The crop builder has not been run against the user's local font archive; this PASS covers code compilation and sampler tests only.

Unicode 17.0 joining metadata registry structure validates; CI passed. Scope is basic Arabic alphabet plus two common extensions. Visual-family/dot metadata is explicitly provisional and does not constitute audited MX-Font component/decomposition labels.

CI generated and validated 1,413 assigned Script=Arabic records from pinned Unicode 17.0 UCD files with source hashes. This is script-level metadata, not a language-specific gold corpus or visual decomposition dataset.
Schema and validator implemented; this does not mean any glyphs have been annotated or independently reviewed.
Regression inputs and HarfBuzz capture runner exist, but no run against a legally cleared font has been performed yet.
Per-component polygon agreement analyzer and unit tests passed. This validates the comparison tool, not actual human agreement; no real double-annotated pilot has yet been created.

Per-file rights manifest schema, fail-closed validator, and batch HarfBuzz runner are implemented. The template is intentionally empty; no font-specific ML-training permissions have been reviewed or approved yet.

upstream.compatibility_note: Upstream train_MX.py uses CUDA APIs and NCCL; Windows/device compatibility is not established.

data.existing_raster_dataset_description: Repository handoff documentation reports 7,904 contextual raster samples; the local agent must verify the release archive and actual contents.

resource_estimate.reason: Requires actual hardware and completed model/data implementation.

blockers: Populate and independently review the per-file font rights manifest with authoritative license evidence and exact SHA-256 values; run batch HarfBuzz only after the gate passes.
Run the isolated-crop builder on the downloaded licensed font corpus and review generated crops; this adapter is not contextual joining/ligature supervision.
Complete per-font asset-level ML-training rights review.
Implement and test an adapter to the pinned upstream MX-Font native loader; current project episodes are an intermediate schema.

Develop and audit expert-reviewed Arabic visual decomposition/component labels required for MX-Font weak component supervision, or document a justified alternative objective. The starter registry covers joining metadata only.
Complete the upstream dependency/license audit and reproduce the baseline in a supported environment; CUDA/NCCL Windows compatibility remains unverified.
Populate provenance-reviewed prompt/geometry pairs and implement image, prompt, and hybrid model paths sharing one generator.
Pass leakage, model forward/backward, checkpoint round-trip/resume, held-out-family evaluation, and local hardware/resource gates.
Run HarfBuzz regression suite against legally cleared font families and review cluster mappings, contextual joins, lam-alef, ZWJ/ZWNJ, and mark attachment.
Create independently annotated glyph-instance samples with two annotators and adjudication; annotation schema alone is not training data.
recommended_next_step: On the local Windows machine, complete the per-file font rights manifest for at least three distinct Arabic font families, run the rights validator and batch HarfBuzz regression, then create the stratified glyph-instance pilot for two independent annotators. Training remains blocked.
